text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after winning the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
It's time for "That Girl's Secrets"! Today 
we're visiting Tracen Academy. ...Now 
then, who is our special guest for today?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Conquering the NHK Mile Cup, Mile CS, and 
the Yasuda Kinen to truly master the mile—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! The world's strongest Umamusume, El 
Condor Pasa is heeeere-desu!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
And so, today we'd like to ask the two of 
you for some behind-the-scenes stories 
about El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fufun! Ask me anything you want!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's dream is to be the strongest in the 
world! I've been El-El-ing my way through 
the Twinkle Series with that goal in mind!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A few teeny-tiny things happened during 
the Classic Year, ...but my dream hasn't 
changed at all, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So my current goal is to conquer the 
Senior Year Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still... before we get there, I must make 
El's power known even more!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Even in pro wrestling, the stronger the 
wrestlers are, the more hype it gets!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, um... mastering the mile was 
something I had planned to attempt all 
along, yes!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! Is that so!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be frank, half of it was justification 
after the fact... Nonetheless, that 
doesn't change the fact that a great feat 
was achieved."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see! Things are really starting to heat 
up on the program, aren't they~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, interviews about her 
debut and other Umamusume of her 
generation were held at various places. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now, for our final stop, we're visiting 
the trainer room used by the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
From the championship sashes of past 
titles to the roadmap leading up to the 
present, this space lets you glimpse the 
journey the two of you have shared.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! In other words, it is El and 
Trainer-san's secret base! Desu!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Did you face any hardships while chasing 
such a big dream, after all?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, since El is the strongest, I 
breezed through everything with flying 
colors!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Que!?
choice_data_list:
Still, I really think you did your 
absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her own way, El Condor Pasa pursued her 
ideals in the Twinkle Series, producing 
results without losing heart even through 
doubts and changes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I carefully chose my words to convey 
everything I'd seen in her up until now."

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even someone as bright and 
cheerful as her has faced many hardships, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
“Even so, never letting it show and 
constantly keeping the crowd entertained 
is *so* El Cóndor Pasa!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fuh... Fuh-ha-ha-ha! Of course, of course!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Getting everyone hyped up and making sure 
they have a blast, THAT is El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...That's right, YES! But, umm, well, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Being praised by Trainer makes me feel 
just a tiiiiny bit ticklish...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The conversation continued to flow lively 
for a while after, and then—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now, to wrap things up, a few words from 
the two of you, please!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well then, Trainer, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What is the name of Trainer's proudest 
Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What is the name of the Umamusume who has 
mastered the mile?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And what is the name of the Umamusume who 
will conquer the world as well—?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's Twinkle Series isn't over yet! Please 
keep cheering for me, desu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With El Condor Pasa's cheerful smile, the 
broadcast came to a close.
